meta.description: Fumana abantu abanezakhono kufutshane nawe. Funyanwa ngomsebenzi owaziyo.

hero.subhead: USebenza udibanisa italente yaseMzantsi Afrika nomsebenzi ngesakhono nangendawo, ngedatha yengqesho onokuyithemba ngokwenene.

pulseStrip.heading: Isingqi sesizwe
pulseStrip.subheading: Siphila, silinganiswa ngokutsha kwedatha. Asize sibe sidala, asize sijikwe.

trusted.title: Iiprofayile ezithembekileyo
trusted.body: Zonke iziqinisekiso zinemeko yokuqinisekiswa enyanisekileyo. Akukho nto ithi "Iqinisekisiwe" ngokuzenzekelayo.

live.title: Ukufumaneka kwangoku
live.body: I-Talent Pulse yethu igcina imeko yengqesho intsha rhoqo. Okudala kuhliswa kuluhlu, akufihlwa.

real.title: Idatha yengqesho yokwenene
real.body: Ukuqeshwa kubalwa kuphela xa kuqinisekisiwe kwiqonga. Amanani onokuwasebenzisa ngokuzithemba.

employer.heading: Fumana italente eqinisekisiweyo, efumanekayo kwisixeko sakho.
employer.body: Khangela ngesakhono nangendawo. Iinkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano zivela kuphela emva kokuba umntu evumile, kwaye konke ukuvulwa kuyarekhodwa.

government.heading: Ulwazi lwabasebenzi ngexesha lokwenene.
government.body: Amanani engqesho aphilayo ngesakhono, ngendawo nangokutsha kwedatha. Ayakhutshwa, adityanisiwe, awaze abe ngawomntu.

footer.rights: © {year} Sebenza. Iqonga lesizwe letalente laseMzantsi Afrika.

signIn.heading: Ngena kwiakhawunti yakho
signIn.subhead: Abafuni bomsebenzi, abaqeshi nabalawuli bangena apha. Siza kukusa kwideshbhodi efanelekileyo.
signIn.twoFactor: Ukuqinisekisa ngamanyathelo amabini kuyafuneka kubaqeshi nakubalawuli.

signUp.heading: Joyina uSebenza

seekerCard.title: Mfuni womsebenzi
seekerCard.body: Yakha iprofayile eqinisekisiweyo, gcina imeko yengqesho intsha, kwaye ufunyanwe ngomsebenzi owaziyo.

employerCard.title: Mqeshi okanye umkhangeli wetalente
employerCard.body: Khangela italente eqinisekisiweyo ngesakhono nangendawo. Kufuneka ukuqinisekisa ngamanyathelo amabini. Umbutho wakho kufuneka uqinisekiswe phambi kokuba kuvuleke iinkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano.

signUp.adminNotice: Iiakhawunti zabalawuli zikhutshwa nguSebenza, azizibhalisi. Ukuba umenyiwe, ngena ngeenkcukacha ezikwi-imeyile yesimemo sakho.

step1.heading: Sixelele ukuba ungubani
step1.subhead: Ezi ziseko kuphela. Siza kongeza okunye kwiprofayile yakho emva kwemvume.
step1.citizenHelp: Isetyenziselwa kuphela amanani ezengqesho nokuqaqanjiswa kwabemi baseMzantsi Afrika kukhangelo lwabaqeshi. Ayize ichaphazele ukuba ungamsebenzisa na uSebenza okanye ufunyanwe. Wonke umntu udityaniswa ngendawo nangesakhono.
step1.nationalityHelp: Iboniswa kwiprofayile yakho nakwiziphumo zokhangelo ukuze abaqeshi bazi apho uvela khona. USebenza udibanisa ngendawo nangesakhono. Apho uvela khona akuze kube ngumqobo.

step3.heading: Amacandelo okuqala eprofayile yakho
step3.subhead: Ungahlela nayiphi na kwezi kamva kumhleli weprofayile yakho.
step3.studentToggleHint: Khetha oku ukuba ubhalisiwe kwiyunivesithi yaseMzantsi Afrika, iyunivesithi yobuchwepheshe, i-TVET, i-UNISA okanye inkqubo ye-INDLELA. Siza kuthatha iinkcukacha zezifundo zakho ukuze uSebenza akwazi ukukucebisa ngezifundo ezikhethwayo, ii-internship neenkqubo zabaphumeleleyo, hayi ukuqeshwa okupheleleyo kuphela.

stepHints.name: Livela kwiprofayile yakho njengo "Gama L." ngokuzenzekelayo. Ifani yakho epheleleyo ivela kuphela emva kokuba unike imvume yoqhagamshelwano.

employerSignUp.heading: Bhalisa umbutho wakho
employerSignUp.subhead: Umbutho wakho uqala kwimeko ethi "awuqinisekiswanga". Ungakhangela italente, kodwa iinkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano namaxwebhu zihlala zitshixiwe de kugqitywe ukuqinisekiswa.
employerSignUp.twoFactorNote: Ukuqinisekisa ngamanyathelo amabini kunyanzelekile kwiiakhawunti zabaqeshi. Uza kukhokelwa ekusetheni i-TOTP xa ungena okokuqala.

verify.heading: Jonga ibhokisi yakho ye-imeyile
verify.subhead: Sithumele ikhonkco lokuqinisekisa ku-{email}. Licofe ukuze uqinisekise idilesi yakho ye-imeyile.

forgot.heading: Setha kwakhona iphasiwedi yakho
forgot.subhead: Faka i-imeyile yeakhawunti yakho, siza kukuthumelela ikhonkco lokusetha iphasiwedi entsha.

filters.title: Izihluzi
filters.nationalityHelp: USebenza udibanisa ngendawo nangesakhono. Ubuzwe buyaboniswa, kodwa abuze bube ngumqobo.

states.emptyBody: Zama ukwandisa indawo okanye ususe isihluzi. Ukhangelo lwakho luyarekhodwa, lungenagama, ukuze sibonise abenzi bomgaqo-nkqubo apho izikhewu zezakhono zikhona.
states.errorBody: Asikwazanga ukufikelela kuluhlu lwetalente. Nceda uzame kwakhona.

freshness.ageingHelp: Ukusuka kwiintsuku ezingama-30 ukuya kwezingama-90. Kuhliswa kancinci kuluhlu, kuthunyelwa isikhumbuzo.
freshness.staleHelp: Kudlule iintsuku ezingama-90. Kuhliswa kakhulu kuluhlu, kuyavezwa kumanani.

profile.studiesSub: Kuxelwe nguwe de kuqinisekiswe liziko ne-SAQA kwiSigaba 8.

locked.lockedBody: Abaqeshi abaqinisekisiweyo bangacela ukujonga oku. Konke ukuvulwa kujongwa ngemvume kwaye kuyarekhodwa.
locked.seekerHint: Asize sibonise inombolo yakho yesazisi, amaxwebhu okanye iinkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano kwiziphumo zokhangelo, nkqu nakubaqeshi abaqinisekisiweyo, de uvume.

profile.redacted: (Ifani ifihliwe kukhangelo loluntu de uvume ukuqhagamshelwana.)

overview.nextAction: Yongeza {n, plural, =1 {isakhono esinye} other {izakhono ezingu-#}} ukuze unyuke kukhangelo.
overview.noViewers: Akukho mntu ujonge iprofayile yakho okwangoku.
overview.rankExplain: Indawo yakho kuluhlu lwabapheki · Western Cape, ngokutsha kwedatha × ukuphelela.

profileEditor.title: Umhleli weprofayile
profileEditor.subtitle: Konke okulapha kungena kuxwebhu lwakho loluntu nakumanani esizwe. Asize sibonise inombolo yakho yesazisi. Ifihlwa ngokubethelwa xa igcinwa.

academic.heading: Izifundo zakho
academic.subhead: Sixelele ukuba ufunda phi kwaye ufunda ntoni. USebenza uza kulungisa ikhampasi yakho yomsebenzi ngokwenkqubo yakho nangexesha eliseleyo phambi kokuphumelela.
academic.kindHint: Amaziko aseMzantsi Afrika amkelweyo kuphela: iiyunivesithi zikarhulumente, iiyunivesithi zobuchwepheshe, iikholeji ze-TVET, i-UNISA, i-INDLELA.
academic.verificationNote: Asize sibonise ibheji ethi 'iqinisekisiwe' kubhaliso oluxelwe nguwe. Ukuqinisekiswa kufika ngobambiswano ne-SAQA namaziko kwiSigaba 8.

fields.displayNameHelp: Indlela ovela ngayo kukhangelo loluntu (umz. "Thandeka M."). Ifani yakho ivela kuphela emva kwemvume yoqhagamshelwano.
fields.headline: Umxholo woluntu
fields.bioHelp: Izivakalisi ezibini okanye ezithathu: into oyenza kakuhle, nento oyifunayo.

profileEditor.savedHint: Kuzigcina njengoko ubhala. Amacandelo abethelweyo agcinwa xa uphuma kuwo.

experience.title: Amava
experience.subtitle: Izikhundla, imihla, impumelelo. Hlela kwakhona nanini na.
experience.empty: Awukongezi mava okwangoku. Ukongeza izikhundla ezintathu nangaphezulu kunyusa indawo yakho kakhulu.

qualifications.title: Iziqinisekiso namaxwebhu
qualifications.subtitle: Layisha izatifikethi njengee-PDF okanye imifanekiso. Iifayile zigcinwa kwindawo yabucala. Ngabaqeshi abaqinisekisiweyo kuphela abanokucela ukuzijonga, kwaye konke ukuvulwa kuyarekhodwa.
qualifications.empty: Akukho ziqinisekiso okwangoku. Ukongeza ubuncinane isatifikethi somsebenzi wezandla okanye idiploma kwakha ukuthenjwa ngabaqeshi.

activity.title: Imisebenzi yakutsha nje
activity.subtitle: Konke ukusetyenziswa kweprofayile yakho, kurekhodiwe ukuze ubone konke ngokucacileyo.

grow.title: Ikhampasi yomsebenzi
grow.subtitle: Into omawuyifunde ngokulandelayo, isekelwe kwimfuno yokwenene yabaqeshi kufutshane nawe. Asithengisi zifundo; sikhomba okusebenzayo.
grow.headline: Funda {n, plural, =1 {isakhono esingu-#} other {izakhono ezingu-#}} → suka ku-#{from} uye ku-#{to}
grow.recommendationsSub: Zikhethwe kwezona zikhewu zinkulu phakathi koko abaqeshi bakukhangelayo noko bakufumanayo.
grow.demandSignal: Ukhangelo olungu-{searches} xa kuthelekiswa nokufunyanwa okungu-{matches} kule nyanga
grow.pathsSub: Okusimahla nokuxhasiweyo kuvela kuqala. Iinkqubo ezamkelwe eMzantsi Afrika kuphela: i-SETA, i-TVET, i-INDLELA, ezamkelwe yi-SAQA, nezixhobo ezivulekileyo.
grow.adjacentSub: Izikhundla izakhono zakho ezidibana nazo, ngesiqhelo ngesakhono esinye okanye ezibini.
grow.cityDemandSub: Apho isikhewu sikhulu khona, imfuno igqitha ukufumaneka. Izakhono ezikwenza ugqame kufutshane nawe. Cofa isakhono ubone ukuba ngoobani abanye abakuluhlu lwaso kwiphondo lakho.
grow.honestBody: USebenza akamkeli mali kubaboneleli bezifundo. Sibeka iindlela zikawonke-wonke ezamkelwe eMzantsi Afrika kuqala kuba zezokwenene kwaye ziyafikeleleka. Ukuba isifundo asikho apha, ayithethi ukuba sibi, kodwa asiyi kusiveza ngaphandle kobungqina bokuba siyasebenza.

student.headline: Dibanisa isidanga sakho nemarike
student.subhead: U-{months, plural, =0 {phumelela kule nyanga} =1 {kwinyanga enye phambi kokuphumelela} other {kwiinyanga ezingu-# phambi kokuphumelela}}. USebenza ulungisa kwakhona iingcebiso ngoko abaphumelele be-{programme} bakudinga ngokwenene ngokulandelayo.
student.electivesSub: Izifundo osenokuzikhetha, zikhethwe kuba imarike izifuna kakhulu kwiphondo lakho.
student.demandSignal: Ukhangelo olungu-{searches} xa kuthelekiswa nokufunyanwa okungu-{matches} kule nyanga
student.programmesSub: Iinkqubo zokwenene zaseMzantsi Afrika: icandelo likarhulumente kuqala, kulandele iinkampani nee-startup. Imiqathango iboniswa ngokunyanisekileyo. Sikhetha ukukuxelela kwangaphambili ukuba awufaneleki kunokuchitha ixesha lakho.
student.destinationsSub: Kudityaniswe kubekwo oluqinisekisiweyo kuSebenza. Akukho datha yamntu ivezwayo, uhlobo lwendawo nesabelo kuphela.
student.medianMonths: {months, plural, =1 {≈inyanga enye de kubekwe} other {≈iinyanga ezingu-# de kubekwe}}
student.supplementarySub: Izikhewu phantse wonke umphumeleli we-CS / we-accounting angena nazo kwisikhundla sokuqala. Konke kusimahla.

cv.pageHelp: Yakhiwa kwiprofayile osele uyizalisile. Khetha uyilo uze uyigcine njenge-PDF. Yeyakho wedwa. Akukho nto apha yabelwana nabaqeshi.
cv.printHint: Gcina njenge-PDF: cofa iqhosha (okanye File → Print) uze ukhethe "Save as PDF".
cv.templateClassicHint: Ikholam enye ecocekileyo. Eyona ikhuselekileyo kwiinkqubo zabaqeshi.
cv.templateCompactHint: Iikholam ezimbini kwisikrini esikhulu; ikholam enye kwifowuni yakho nasekuprinteni.
cv.emptyTitle: I-CV yakho incinci kuba iprofayile yakho incinci
cv.emptyBody: Yongeza izakhono zakho, imbali yomsebenzi neziqinisekiso kwiprofayile yakho, uze ubuye. I-CV yakho izizalisa ngokwayo.
cv.backupNoteBody: Ugcine i-PDF? Yilayishe kwindawo yakho yabucala yokugcina i-CV ukuze ukwazi ukuyikhuphela kwakhona kuso nasiphi na isixhobo.
cv.honestNote: Izakhono zibonisa inqanaba ozinike lona, njengakwiprofayile yakho yoluntu. Akuze kuthiwe "iqinisekisiwe" ngaphandle kokuqinisekiswa ngumqeshi okanye liziko.

workReady.title: Zilungiselele umsebenzi, ungapheleli ekuwufumaneni
workReady.lead: Izikhokelo ezimfutshane ezisebenzayo, ne-CV eyakhiwa kwiprofayile yakho ngokucofa kanye.
workReady.prepareLead: Usamkele esi simemo. Nantsi indlela yokuzilungiselela.

nearYou.beFoundBody: KuSebenza, abaqeshi beza kuwe. Ukuba iprofayile yakho intsha kwaye iphelele, bakufumana lula kufutshane ne-{city}.

nearYou.remote: Uvulekele nokusebenza ukude: {count, plural, one {ukhangelo olungu-#} other {ukhangelo olungu-#}} lwe-{profession} kulo lonke elaseMzantsi Afrika.

overview.placementNudge: Umqeshile lo mntu? Ukuqinisekisa ukuqesha kugcina idatha yesizwe inyanisekile, kwaye umbutho wakho ufumana ikhredithi encinci yamanani.
overview.noMatches: Akukho nto ifunyenweyo kolu khangelo lugciniweyo
overview.broadenHelp: Yandisa izihluzi zakho, okanye ugcine isikhewu. Sisifaka kumanani esizwe ezikhewu zezakhono.

savedSearches.title: Ukhangelo olugciniweyo
savedSearches.subtitle: Iiseti zezihluzi eziphinda zisetyenziswe. Okufunyenwe okutsha kukwazisa nge-imeyile. Nguwe ogqiba ukuba kangaphi.
savedSearches.newMatches: {n, plural, =1 {okufunyenwe okutsha okungu-#} other {okufunyenwe okutsha okungu-#}} ukususela kutyelelo lwakho lokugqibela

shortlists.title: Amaqela etalente
shortlists.subtitle: Uluhlu olukhethiweyo ngesikhundla okanye ngephulo. Yabelana ngaphakathi; ungaze ukhuphe iinkcukacha zomntu.

placements.title: Ukubekwa
placements.subtitle: Konke ukuqesha umbutho wakho okuqinisekisileyo kuSebenza. Kungena kumanani esizwe okubekwa (iSigaba 6).
placements.noPlacements: Akukho kubekwa kufakiweyo okwangoku. Faka ukuqesha kwakho kokuqala ukuze ufumane ikhredithi encinci yamanani.

organisation.title: Umbutho
organisation.subtitle: Iprofayile yakho ebhalisiweyo. Imeko yokuqinisekiswa igqiba into onokuyivula.

team.title: Iqela
team.subtitle: Yongeza oogxa bakho kwindawo yakho yokusebenza. Ukufikelela kwelungu ngalinye kurekhodwa ngokwahlukeneyo.

verifications.title: Umgca wokuqinisekisa
verifications.subtitle: Phonononga iziqinisekiso nemibutho. Vuma, yala ngesizathu, okanye udlulisele phezulu.

moderation.title: Umgca wolawulo
moderation.subtitle: Iiprofayile nomxholo oxeliweyo. Nqumamisa, buyisela, okanye vala ngaphandle kwenyathelo.

taxonomy.title: Idatha esisiseko
taxonomy.subtitle: Amagama alawulweyo. Akukho mbhalo ukhululekileyo kukhangelo.

auditLog.title: Ilog yophicotho
auditLog.subtitle: Konke ukufikelela kwe-PII, ngokulandelelana kwexesha. Ukugcinwa okuhambelana ne-POPIA kuyasebenza.
auditLog.noEvents: Akukho kufikelela kwe-PII okwangoku kule seshoni. Tyelela ku-/search okanye uvule iprofayile uze ulayishe kwakhona. Zonke iziganeko ziza kuvela apha.

users.title: Abasebenzisi
users.subtitle: Khangela ngesiphatho, nge-imeyile okanye ngendima. Izenzo zeakhawunti ziyarekhodwa.

settings.title: Iisetingi zeqonga
settings.subtitle: Iiflegi zeempawu, iibhendi zokutsha kwedatha, ubunzima bokubeka uluhlu.

insights.title: Iinkcukacha zengqesho
insights.subtitle: Kulinganiswa ngokutsha kwedatha. Kudityanisiwe kuphela. Kuhlaziywa rhoqo.
insights.skillsGapHelp: Xa ukhangelo lugqitha ukufunyanwa kakhulu, sinesikhewu sezakhono. Eli lelona xhobo lomgaqo-nkqubo.
insights.confidenceHelp: Ukuzithemba kokutsha kwedatha: okukhona isabelo seemeko eziqinisekiswe kutsha nje siphezulu, kokukhona ukuzithemba kuphezulu.
insights.exportNote: Okukhutshwayo kudityanisiwe kuphela. Akukho datha yamntu iphuma kwinkqubo. Konke ukukhutshwa kuyarekhodwa.

errors.notFoundBody: Ikhonkco lisenokuba lidala, libhalwe kakubi, okanye iphepha lifudukile. Abantu basekho noko, ngoko khangela into oze ngayo ngokwenene.
errors.errorBody: Kwenzeke impazamo engalindelekanga. Nceda uzame kwakhona.
errors.errorDigestHint: Ukuba uqhagamshelana nathi ngoku, khankanya le khowudi
